enemies.description: The lowliest of Terminids, slow and weak, but capable of attracting nearby bug breaches.
One of the smallest Terminids, but still deadly with its ranged acid spit.
Agile Terminids that are able to leap great distances to attack Helldivers.
Stealthy Terminids engaging in ambush tactics, able to leap great distances and slow Helldivers with their tongue.
Flying Terminids specialized in hit-and-run tactics.
Medium sized Terminid adept in close-quarters combat.
A mutated variant of the Warrior that explodes upon death.
A faster and deadlier variant of the Warrior. Spawned by Alpha Commanders.
A variant of the Warrior with medium armor covering its head and legs.
A sluggish, medium armored Terminid that can spew corrosive bile over a wide area.
An armored variant of the Nursing Spewer capable of launching Bile mortars.
Leadership-class Terminid capable of coordinating attacks and deploying reinforcements.
A heavier variant of the Brood Commander, capable of calling in Alpha Warriors.
A specialized Terminid capable of turning partially invisible and ambushing Helldivers. Spawns from Stalker Lairs.
Fast-moving Terminid specialized in charging attacks. Covered head to claw in heavy armor.
A Charger variant that creates a thick fog and a massive explosion on death.
A Charger variant with even more durable armor.
Heavily armored Terminid that uses large, bladed tentacles to disrupt Helldiver movements.
Massive Terminid with a potent bile attack, stomp attacks, and heavy armor.
Massive flying Terminid with a potent fire breath attack and heavy armor.
Gigantic Terminid capable of traversing underground, expelling bile and crushing targets with its body weight.
A mutated variant of the Hunter that is significantly more aggressive, capable of cloaking, and can spew bile.
A mutated, more aggressive variant of the Stalker that is unable to cloak but spawns as a regular part of patrols.
A mutated variant of the Scavenger that explodes into a deadly spore cloud upon death.
A mutated variant of the Hunter that explodes into a deadly spore cloud upon death.
A mutated variant of the Warrior that explodes into a deadly spore cloud upon death.
A mutated variant of the Bile Titan with a potent bile spew capable of buffing nearby enemies.
A burrowing variant of the Warrior.
A burrowing variant of the Bile Spewer.
A burrowing variant of the Charger.
Light Automaton unit armed with a fusion SMG and explosive grenades.
Light Automaton unit armed with twin heated blades that specializes in close quarters combat.
Light Automaton squad leader armed with sidearm and heat blade for versatile offensive options.
Light Automaton unit armed with a rocket launcher.
Light Automaton unit armed with a fusion pistol, a blade, and a jetpack.
Reinforced Automaton unit armed with a fusion rifle and explosive grenades.
Reinforced Automaton unit armed with a fusion machine gun, explosive grenades, and a volatile backpack with a tendency to explode.
Durable Automaton unit armed with dual chainsaws that specialize in close quarters combat.
Medium-armored Automaton unit armed with fusion assault cannons.
Devastator variant armed with fusion arm cannons and shoulder-mounted rocket launchers, capable of hitting Helldivers behind cover.
Devastator variant armed with a fusion machine gun and a large shield, capable of suppressing Helldivers and blocking incoming fire.
Armored Automaton recon walker, armed with a heavy fusion repeater and manned by a single Trooper shielded from small arms fire from the front.
A reinforced variant of the Scout Strider armed with rockets and armor surrounding the entire pilot.
Large, heavily armored Automaton unit armed with dual rocket launchers.
Hulk variant armed with a heavy flamethrower and large sawblade, specializing in close quarters combat.
Hulk variant equipped with a burst rocket launcher and fusion autocannon.
Heavily armored Automaton walker unit armed with Heavy Fusion Repeaters and explosive grenade launchers.
Tank-armored Automaton unit armed with fusion machine guns and a large cannon.
Tank variant armed with a quad-linked heavy fusion cycler turret.
Tank variant armed with a large missile array capable of direct & mortar fire.
Medium-armored flying Automaton unit armed with fusion machine guns and rockets.
Unarmed Automaton ship that drops in fellow Automaton units in response to a Bot Drop flare.
Massive Automaton quad-walker, armed with twin fusion gatling guns and a large burst-cannon. Capable of creating and deploying squads of Devastators.
Commissar variant equipped with a jetpack for leaping large distances.
Trooper variant equipped with a jetpack for leaping large distances.
MG Raider variant equipped with a jetpack for leaping large distances.
Devastator variant equipped with a jetpack for leaping large distances.
A variant of the Hulk Scorcher equipped with a large jetpack, allowing them to leap great distances.
A variant of the Hulk Bruiser equipped with a large jetpack, allowing them to leap great distances.
Reinforced Automaton unit equipped with a flamethrower and a backpack-mounted fuel tank.
Light Automaton unit armed with a specialized rocket launcher.
Heavy Devastator variant with a slower firing incendiary fusion machine gun.
Devastator variant armed with an incendiary fusion shotgun and a large shield, capable of suppressing Helldivers and blocking incoming fire.
Hulk variant equipped with a large flamethrower and incendiary grenade launcher.
Cybernetically enhanced human soldiers equipped with a heavy shotgun and "techno-martial arts."
Cyborg field commanders, able to take direct command of their Automaton underlings.
Massive Cyborg Mech equipped with heavy fusion cannons, a missile array and gatling guns.
An Agile skirmisher unit that attacks in hordes.
Flying drone equipped with arc weaponry and the ability to call for reinforcements.
Elite unit equipped with an energy shield and a deadly lance capable of launching an explosive projectile, usually accompanies hordes of Voteless.
Elite unit equipped with automatic plasma rifles and jet-packs, usually accompanies hordes of Voteless.
Elite unit equipped with a large plasma cannon, capable of direct & mortar fire, usually accompanies hordes of Voteless.
An amalgamation of Voteless corpses, this large Illuminate unit specializes in close quarters combat and charges at Helldivers to attack.
Massive autonomous tripod with an energy shield and a large laser weapon. Can also use arc weaponry in close-quarters.
Flying Illuminate unit that deploys strafing runs against Helldivers, dealing massive damage over a large area.
Transport aircraft used for deploying reinforcements for the Illuminate.
Tank-armored flying Illuminate unit, armed with large beams cannons and bomb bays.
Unarmed host ships, these units act as command centers for Illuminate ground forces.
A piloted Illuminate war machine, with arm-like appendages.
A piloted Illuminate war machine, with plasma guns and increased armor.
Swarming drones that fire plasma projectiles and travel in groups. A variation of the watcher.
Former Super Earth citizens twisted beyond recognition into ravenous predators as violent as they are nimble.
Ungainly flesh amalgamations that wield massive metallic clubs and are capable of regenerating tissue damage.
Unarmed Super Earth citizens, mostly found running away from danger.
Lightly-armored Super Earth ground troops, variously armed with assault rifles, SMGs, machine guns, expendable anti-tank launchers, and explosive grenades.
Super Earth's elite fighting force, these units can be equipped with a variety of weapons, stratagems, and employ a variety of tactics.
